Global Missions As a church founded more than a century ago, MABC has a long history of sending missionaries and Christian workers overseas — more than 100 people, to 25 countries across Asia, Africa and the Pacific. We now partner with a number of missionaries, providing prayer, encouragement and, for some, financial support. We also support the Baptist Mission Fellowship. To find out more, email missions@mabc.org.nz

International Ministries We are a multicultural church that welcomes anyone and everyone. People from other countries who have made their home in New Zealand have a special place in our church. What we stand for We love being a multi-cultural bunch of all ages and stages of faith, from those exploring Christianity to others who have been walking the talk for years. We invite you to come as you are, but not stay as you are — we want our lives to be transformed by Jesus. That is why Mt Albert Baptist is a place to connect, grow, serve and give. We like to make a difference by engaging with the world around us so that others can experience God’s love. Each year we run events in our community, from Global Café Nights to our International Street Food Festival.

How it all began Mt Albert Baptist began over a century ago, when two enterprising 24-year-olds decided to start a new church to impact the local community. It took guts and passion for good friends Ross Penman and Harvey Turner to start a church in the early 1900s. They could see the Mt Albert population growing, and that more people wanted to go to church locally. Their vision caught on, and they pooled resources with other families to buy land — at four pounds an acre — and build the first church hall. Constituted September 1915 With 21 founding members, gathering for Bible-based teaching and community work Today More than 300 people call Mt Albert Baptist their home church Sent overseas More than 100 people, to 25 countries Across Asia, Africa and the Pacific
